_about: Gaps and problems found while pulling data.

gaps.text: "Exodus 15:23" (listed under mara): STEPBible doesn't tag H4755 there. It's a related word at most; the note should say so or the reference should go.
"1 Samuel 1:10" (listed under mara): STEPBible doesn't tag H4755 there. It's a related word at most; the note should say so or the reference should go.
"Numbers 35:19" (listed under goel): STEPBible tags the same word there as H1350H, a different sense ("[the] avenger of"). Fine to keep if the note says so.
Ruth 1: our "Judges 21:25" isn't linked from this chapter in OpenBible's data. Keep it only if we can justify it.
Ruth 1: our "Leviticus 19:9-10" isn't linked from this chapter in OpenBible's data. Keep it only if we can justify it.
Ruth 3: our "Leviticus 25:25" isn't linked from this chapter in OpenBible's data. Keep it only if we can justify it.
The Dead Sea and the Jordan River aren't mentioned in Ruth; they're pulled only to draw the map.
Theographic has no records for unnamed people in Ruth (the closer relative, Boaz's foreman, the women of Bethlehem). Those stay hand-written.
Theographic's descriptions are Easton's Bible Dictionary (1897) and include errors (Chilion's entry calls Orpah "Ruth's sister"). We don't display them.
Theographic's birth and death years aren't used. Dates for this period are debated.
Range of meaning, English renderings, pronunciations, and notes are hand-written and need review. The STEPBible lexicon entry is shown alongside them.
Authorship, dating, audience, historical setting, cultural notes, map stops, the timeline, and chapter summaries come from no dataset. They're marked needs-review.
The HelloAO Free Use Bible API and openbible.info aren't reachable from the build environment, so the WEB text and the cross-reference file come from GitHub mirrors (see the Sources page).
